entities.summary: West India Company, a notable figure in the history of Guyana, associated with European Exploration and Colonial Contest (1616–1700). Preceded by Dutch Settlement and Colonial Foundations and Dutch West India Company. Their legacy influenced Berbice Slave Rebellion led by Cuffy.
